text:
maria: hey team — need to lock the RFC review for next Tue. authors: @kevin, @sophie, @nathan. who can take what slot? trying to keep it to 45m total and get pre-reads in by EOD Mon :hourglass: 

sam: I can do first slot (kevin), prefer earlier since I'm on pacific.

kevin: yep I can present first. will post pre-read in the drive link below by tonight.

maria: thanks — can everyone who plans to present paste a short 1-line TL;DR and the doc link here when done. will order agenda based on complexity and reviewer availability.

kevin: TL;DR: new routing policy + fallback tiers. doc: https://drive.redwood/example/routing-fallback-v2 (uploaded)

calendar-bot: Reminder: proposed meeting time options posted. Vote with "1/2/3" reactions on the poll message.

kevin: +1 for slot 1 (earlier) :thumbsup:

maria: sophie / nathan — are you ok to take slots 2 and 3? if either needs more than 15 mins, call it out now.

sophie: I can do slot 2, but my RFC is a little heavy (design + perf). I'd like 20–25m if possible.

nathan: slot 3 works for me, mine's short (10–12m).

maria: ok pencil in: slot1 kevin (15m), slot2 sophie (25m), slot3 nathan (10m). 5m buffer and 10m triage at end. That totals 65m — oops. can we trim buffer or drop triage?

sam: we can trim buffer to 2m and move triage to a follow-up 30m sync.

sophie: fine with that, but please move my slides earlier in the deck so reviewers see perf numbers first.

maria: noted. reviewers: @sam, @arjun (out of thread), @lina — can you confirm availability?

sam: available.

kevin: tiny ask — can someone take notes / action items? happy to sync offline if not.

maria: @sophie? you're on notes this time?

sophie: I can do notes and capture actions. will create a short template.

maria: pre-read deadline = EOD Mon — please paste link here when done. I'll send final invite Wed morning with ordered agenda and timing.

kevin: done earlier: https://drive.redwood/example/routing-fallback-v2 — comments welcome.

nathan: uploading doc now: https://drive.redwood/example/cache-strategy-v1

sophie: uploaded slides + perf appendix: https://drive.redwood/example/optimizations-ps1

maria: perfect. final checklist: 1) authors upload pre-reads (done) 2) reviewers confirm (sam, arjun, lina) 3) notes owner (sophie) 4) calendar event time locked after poll. if anyone can't attend in person we will record.

calendar-bot: Poll closes in 6 hours. Event will be created after majority vote.

sam: quick Q — can we block 90 minutes on the calendar just in case? some folks may run over.

maria: don't want to over-block org time. we'll keep 75m hard stop and a follow-up 30m if needed.

kevin: +1 agreed. thanks everyone.

maria: thanks — ping me if you need to swap slots. I'll post final agenda tomorrow morning. :sparkles:
